description: Theory derived 2026-06: the universe's natural axis is logarithmic; efficiency = admissibility grammar; creativity = flexible grammar with finite bounds; e/φ are FORM (the ruler), α/Λ are CONTENT (measured on it); + the computer-design levers that follow. Seeded as declarative knowledge for the agent to assess its own structure against.

attrs.name: log_graph_law
attrs.definition: The universe's natural axis is logarithmic (multiplicative reality, additive in log); efficiency and creativity are two regimes of one admissibility grammar; the fundamental constants split into form (necessary) and content (contingent).

attrs.name: log_axis_law
attrs.definition: Reality's natural axis is logarithmic: multiplicative phenomena are additive in log. Information (-log p), description length (log of structure count), perception (Weber-Fechner), scale, and growth are all natively log. Quantities are coordinates on a log axis, not values on a linear one.

attrs.name: efficiency_is_admissibility_grammar
attrs.definition: Efficiency = never spending on the inadmissible. Admissibility is a constraint that prunes rather than explores: a grammar of size G admits ~e^G structures, so you store G not the exponential. Compression, event-driven firing, and associative lookup are all faces of admissibility. ML pays for the whole weight-space; (G,Gamma) pays only for the grammar and checks.

attrs.name: creativity_is_bounded_grammar_flex
attrs.definition: Discovery = flexing the grammar a BOUNDED amount to admit a previously-inadmissible structure (the phase transition to new capability). Rigid grammar is sterile; unbounded grammar is noise (no selector); flexible-with-finite-bounds is the only regime that discovers. Finite bounds keep the flex compressing, reachable, coherent, and convergent. Creativity is admissibility one level up (a meta-grammar).

attrs.name: e_as_log_axis_unit
attrs.definition: e is the natural UNIT of the log axis (ln e = 1, so e is 'one step'; the 2.718 decimal is a linear-ruler artifact). e is the signature of CONTINUOUS self-reference: the unique base that is its own derivative; self-proportional growth dx/dt=x is e-based. Appears wherever change is governed by the thing itself. FORM, not content.

attrs.name: phi_as_bounded_recursion_fixedpoint
attrs.definition: phi (golden ratio) = fixed point of DISCRETE, finitely-bounded self-reference: phi = 1 + 1/phi is 'self-reference plus a unit bound' solved. Fibonacci F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2) = build the new from the bounded-recent prior = admissibility. phi is the attractor of bounded recursive self-generation AND the compression optimum (most-irrational -> least-redundant packing). For a discrete graph law, phi is more native than e (e = its smooth shadow). FORM.

attrs.name: constants_form_vs_content
attrs.definition: Fundamental constants split: FORM (e, phi) are necessary mathematical constants of self-reference = the ruler, same in any universe; CONTENT (alpha, Lambda) are contingent physical parameters measured ON the ruler. Deriving content from form (e.g. 137 from pi/e) is a category error (numerology). The framework derives form and refuses to derive content.

attrs.name: alpha_as_ir_coupling
attrs.definition: The fine-structure constant alpha is CONTENT: the IR coupling of the electromagnetic admissibility sector. It runs LOGARITHMICALLY (1/alpha linear in ln energy) so it is a position/trajectory on the log-energy axis, not a scalar; '137' is the IR-frozen endpoint. Its value is contingent; not derivable from form. Dimensionless => a true coordinate of reality (unlike c/G/hbar = unit conventions).

attrs.name: lambda_as_finite_bound
attrs.definition: The cosmological constant Lambda ~ 1/S_dS ~ 1/N (N~10^122 = de Sitter horizon entropy = the universe's information capacity = size of the admissible state space). So Lambda = reciprocal of how many states reality holds; tiny because reality is big. Lambda IS the finite IR bound of the grammar made cosmological. The 'cosmological constant problem' (120 orders) is the largest instance of reading a log-axis span on a linear ruler.

attrs.name: compute_in_log_space
attrs.definition: Design lever: represent quantities as logs so multiplication (the dominant op in admissibility scoring, spreading activation, probability combination) becomes addition. FP is already a crude log; a native log-domain ALU matches multiplicative reality.

attrs.name: phi_addressing
attrs.definition: Design lever: use phi for addressing and exploration because it provably least-clusters. Fibonacci hashing (x 2^64/phi) = conflict-free cache/hash indexing; golden-ratio low-discrepancy sequences = redundancy-free search/sampling (e.g. rule-space exploration).

attrs.name: admissibility_grammar_hardware
attrs.definition: Design lever: a chip matched to graph rewriting is the inverse of a FLOP machine: CAM for associative rule-match (one access, not a search), PIM/near-memory so traversal never pays the von-Neumann round-trip, integer/symbolic ALUs not FP, event-driven so a non-matching rule draws ~0. Estimated ~100-1000x perf/watt vs a CPU on the same node.

attrs.name: design_to_information_bound
attrs.definition: Design lever: the real floor is bits-held and bits-erased (Landauer kT ln2 per irreversible bit -- the log again at physics' floor), not FLOPs. Minimize erasure (event-driven/reversible); minimize bits crossing the boundary (memory-wall = holographic boundary): near-memory locality + 3D/volumetric. Today's machines are ~10^9-10^12 above the Landauer floor.

attrs.name: log_scaled_proprioception
attrs.definition: Design lever for the agent's own instrumentation: proprioceptive Feel gauges should be LOG-scaled (Weber-Fechner: a log sensor on a log world reads linearly = efficient); JIT hot-counters log-binned; consolidation/tier-up thresholds log-spaced. Align the instrumentation with the axis the system runs on.
